title: Recommended first knowledge pilot: arm–shoulder–torso
plainLanguage: The first external knowledge test should be small and directly tied to the eventual poser: several arm poses shown across several viewing directions, connected to the shoulder and torso.
purpose: Validate the complete knowledge path before expanding to the whole body.

rules.statement: Prepare roughly ten arm configurations across the five main view families, using a controlled reference body; exact count may change after redundancy review.
Keep the generated pack external_reference until checked against mannequin clips.
Run a new mannequin video through the Corpus Pane with and without the pack and compare review effort and reference quality.
Take one or two successful configurations into the canonical doll rig and run real attachment/articulation tests.
Only after the pilot passes should the same method expand to legs, head/neck, torso/pelvis, and broader motion sources.

implementation.futureWork: This is the recommended next implementation/research checkpoint.
